name: Execution Service Public Contract
purpose: Define the public request/response boundary for execution orchestration. Consumers submit verified intent and render normalized outcomes. They do not know provider, signer, contract sequencing, receipt polling, or retry strategy.

recipient.description: Verified recipient address supplied by the requesting surface.

amount.description: Human-entered transfer amount in token units.

token.description: Token symbol for the requested transfer route.

fee.description: Declared fee component for the execution request.

source.description: Originating surface or product source for traceability.

response.description: Every exit path — success, failure, and intermediate — returns exactly this shape. All fields are always present. Null indicates the field is not applicable to the current status. Consumers check status, then read the relevant field. No field is conditionally absent.

status.description: Normalized execution phase. Always present. Consumers branch on this field only.

sender.description: Connected sender address. Present when wallet has been accessed. Null on wallet-missing and wallet-rejected from the prepare phase.

chain.description: Chain identity when the target chain is known. Contains only name and chainId — no config, RPC, or contract details. Present on wrong-network and ready-to-send. Null on wallet-missing, wallet-rejected, confirmed, and failed.

receipt.description: Normalized execution receipt. Present only on confirmed. Null on all other statuses. Raw provider receipts never appear here.

error.description: Normalized failure descriptor. Present on failed. Null on all other statuses. Provider-specific error codes must not appear here.

onWalletRequested.description: Invoked when wallet access is about to be requested.

onWalletConnected.description: Invoked when the sender address has been resolved.

onNetworkMismatch.description: Invoked when the connected wallet is on the wrong network.

onApprovalSubmitted.description: Invoked when approval is submitted to the wallet or provider.

onTransferSubmitted.description: Invoked when the transfer is submitted.

onConfirmed.description: Invoked when the transfer is confirmed.

onFailed.description: Invoked when the request fails or is rejected.

serviceGuarantees: Execution Service fulfills verified intent; it does not author intent.
It must not choose, replace, or reinterpret the recipient.
It must not rewrite amount, token, chain, or fee policy.
It must not require the Transfer Portal.
It may change wallet/provider/approval/receipt strategy without changing the public request shape.
consumerGuarantees: Amount and fee have already been presented to the sender.
The request represents intentional sender action.
The consumer will render normalized outcomes instead of interpreting provider internals.
invariants: Consumers submit verified intent and render normalized outcomes.
Consumers do not know provider, signer, contract sequencing, receipt polling, or retry strategy.
The service may change implementation strategy without changing the consumer-facing request shape.
The service may support Safe wallets, account abstraction, alternative providers, retries, batching, or different execution strategies without requiring Coin Card changes.
The public contract must remain stable until a versioned replacement is declared.
